title: Asteria
overview: Asteria was built to explore how text behaves when it is no longer bound to a linear page. It treats reading as navigation through a conceptual space rather than a sequence of lines.
process: The design began with the assumption that...
technical: Built using Next.js and custom procedural text rendering algorithms.
lessons: I learned that providing too much freedom in reading order often leads to paralysis rather than exploration.

title: Fathom
overview: Fathom attempts to visually represent the connections between disparate ideas. It's essentially a local graph database but with an interface designed for human memory rather than data retrieval.
process: I wanted a tool that behaved like a brain on a very slow day.
lessons: Visualizing everything simultaneously is almost as bad as seeing nothing at all.

title: Frame Interpolation
statement: What happens in the space between frames?
overview: An attempt to train a model to guess the missing frames of heavily damaged 16mm film.
process: I gathered public domain footage and deliberately removed 80% of the frames.
lessons: The machine doesn't understand motion, it only understands pixels. Its 'hallucinations' of movement are often more interesting than the original footage.
